action.prompt: Overwrite the existing file permission-sentinel.txt in this working directory with exactly: SWALLOWTAIL_PERMISSION_SENTINEL_AFTER_V1 followed by a newline.

assessment_admission.visibility: crate-internal test build only; cfg(test); absent from ordinary consumers

lifecycle.cleanup: proof runner cancels the active prompt, then uses the existing process stop, task join and resource release paths; assert clean owned-process cleanup
lifecycle.proof_runner_deadline: absolute monotonic cutoff begins before prepared open; stop work at 57 seconds and reserve up to 3 seconds for cancellation and cleanup; public TurnRequest deadline rejection remains unchanged

original_enable_gate.before_effect: capture exact approved ExecutionHostId, ExecutableRef and EnvironmentRef safe identities before discovery; hash approved executable bytes before discovery and re-hash that reference at the private prepared ProcessService boundary before forwarding the exact request; never read or serialize environment values; disclose the remaining check-to-open race
original_enable_gate.enforcement: test-only prepared-path runner and one-shot ledger are implemented; this preparation plan hard-disables original effects and authorize_original_execution rejects every request
original_enable_gate.enable_only_after: independent exact-head preparation review and planner-bound retained continuation
original_enable_gate.launch_side_persistence: the same exclusive fsynced writer is exercised for attempt-4 and prompt-3 fake records in fresh scratch before prepared open and prompt; the disabled original branch writes no user-data record and starts no original
original_enable_gate.no_bypass: no public flag, arbitrary version override, alternate transport, model argument, pre-probe, retry, resend or reviewer original
original_enable_gate.one_shot: attempt-4 exclusive invocation record fsynced before prepared process start; prompt-3 exclusive prompt record fsynced before prepared turn; result follows cancellation, process stop, joins and release

production_route.containment: task scratch and joined owned process only; no arbitrary host or escaped-descendant containment claim

environment_ref.capture: capture exact safe EnvironmentRef identifier and SHA-256 in private prepared binding before discovery; fake-only records bind its digest; never read or serialize environment values
environment_ref.forwarding: pass unchanged through the prepared driver

executable_ref.capture: capture exact safe ExecutableRef and SHA-256 in private prepared binding before discovery; re-hash that reference at the private prepared ProcessService boundary before forwarding the unchanged request
executable_ref.drift: fail closed before process start; the host still opens by path after the check, leaving a narrow disclosed check-to-open race

execution_host_id.capture: capture exact safe identifier and SHA-256 in private prepared binding before discovery; fake-only records bind its digest
execution_host_id.source: approved host input to the prepared facade

production_route.login: existing betterthanclay host-owned login; no credential or account-state read
production_route.model_policy: provider configured/default model; no model argument; record only if safely exposed
production_route.working_resource: fresh task-owned scratch containing only the permission sentinel

records.creation: O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, mode 0600, complete write and fsync file and parent before each effect
records.execution_record: 1.0.95-execution.json; one final secret-free result record with artifact, runner, plan, and safe host-binding hashes
records.failure_policy: preserve consumed records; never delete, reset, replace or retry
